The '''Z-Gomot Ternbuell Guppat Corporation''' was a manufacturer which was part of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. Based in the [[Zug system/Legends|Zug system]], the corporation manufactured [[Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike]]s. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] used this type of wheel bike during his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] occupation of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone wars]].
